audit_items.proof_trace: Zero-amount deposits are caught before any arithmetic by `assert!(coin.value() != 0, error::no_zero_amount())` in `handle_mint` (market.move:264, error 213), and zero-amount borrows are caught by the identical guard in `handle_borrow` (market.move:375). Overflow amounts (> U64_MAX) are structurally unreachable because both parameters are typed `u64`, which the Move VM enforces at the transaction deserialization boundary. All deposit paths funnel through `handle_mint` (sole caller of `mint_ctokens`) and all borrow paths funnel through `handle_borrow`, so there are no bypass paths.
